main_text.p: turis Synodis Oecumenicis, & vniuersali Ecclefiæ legem, pœnis statutis, imponere valeat, quam si non seruauerint, ob delictum contra legem datam commissum plectendæ veniant: nunquid propterea Romana Ecclefia addens in Symbolo, Filioque, pœnas indictas persoluet? Nihil minus. Pendamus verba Synodi. Decretum est post Symbolum absq; additione pronunciatum: Si quis aliam fidem in hoc sancto Symbolo addiderit, vel aliquid dempserit, vel immutauerit, si ex sacratis Deo hominibus est, omnimodæ depositioni, si ex laicorum ordine, anathemati subiiciatur. Εἰ μὲν [?] ... [illegible, ~60 letters] ... ἀναθεματισμῷ ὑποβ[?]. Prohibetur alia fides, contraria nempe, scriptæ aduersans, repugnans, aliena, externa. Sed fidei in Symbolo Nicæno, vel Constantinopolitano traditæ, nullo modo aduersatur, neque repugnat additio Filioque, cum id multo ante Photiana tempora tenuerint atq; deprædicauerint Ecclefiæ Orientalis, & Occidentalis, Patres, & Doctores Ecclefiæ Græcæ, & Latinæ, & illius vestigia satisperspicua, & manifesta in sacris literis habeantur, vt alibi sæpius fuse probauimus. Non affi-cit ergo Romanam Ecclefiam cohærentem, aptam, & cõsentaneam Symbolo veritatem

page.notes: The page is printed in roman type with the Greek sentence in the middle of the text. Only fragments of the Greek are legible at this scan resolution; the rest is marked as illegible. Stray dots and specks at the foot and on the left edge are stains, not print, and are left out. The spelling "Ecclefiæ" uses long s (printed as f) and is transcribed with plain s as the rules require. The printed punctuation "pronunciatum :" and "minus ." is kept as printed. The catchword "ad-" is at the foot, and the last full line ends with "veritatem".
